and key checkpoints.\"\"\"\n    shot = output_dir / f\"{stamp}_{tag}.png\"\n    html = output_dir / f\"{stamp}_{tag}.html\"\n    await page.screenshot(path=str(shot), full_page=True)\n    html.write_text(await page.content())\n    return shot, html\n"
}

All clean. Three files:
- `scrapers/_common.py` — shared helpers (cookies, remember-me, login click, screenshot dumps, path setup)
- `scrapers/amex.py` — refactored to use `_common`, behavior unchanged
- `scrapers/barclaycard.py` — first slice (login + dump state, no download yet)

**For Barclaycard**, in Bitwarden you probably want an item named `barclaycard` with:
- **Username** = your membership ID (or whatever you use to log in)
- **Password** = your 5-digit passcode

(If your Bitwarden item is named differently, set `export BARCLAYCARD_BW_ITEM="..."` before running.)

Run it:

```bash
cd /Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus
source venv/bin/activate
export BW_SESSION="$(bw unlock --raw)"
python -m scrapers.barclaycard --headed
```

Things to watch for on first run:
- The login may be **two steps** (username on one page, passcode on the next) — I handle this by clicking Continue if the passcode field isn't visible after filling the username
- You'll probably get a **memorable-word prompt** ("enter the 1st, 4th, and 7th characters") — do that manually in the browser for now
- Look for any **"Remember this device"** option after OTP and tick it

Once it lands on the dashboard, the script dumps a screenshot + HTML. Send me the screenshot path (or just tell me what's on the page) and I'll wire up the download flow.

To get one:\n         export BW_SESSION=\"$(bw unlock --raw)\"\n\nReturns (username, password) or (None, None) if nothing resolved.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport subprocess\n\n\ndef get_credentials(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    upper = provider.upper()\n\n    u = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_USERNAME\")\n    p = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_PASSWORD\")\n    if u and p:\n        return u, p\n\n    item_name = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_BW_ITEM\", provider)\n    return _from_bitwarden(item_name)\n\n\ndef _from_bitwarden(item_name: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    session = os.environ.get(\"BW_SESSION\")\n    if not session:\n        return None, None\n\n    try:\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [\"bw\", \"get\", \"item\", item_name, \"--session\", session],\n            capture_output=True,\n            text=True,\n            timeout=15,\n        )\n    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):\n        return None, None\n\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        return None, None\n\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(result.stdout)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return None, None\n\n    login = (data.get(\"login\") or {})\n    return login.get(\"username\"), login.get(\"password\")",

Bitwarden CLI: looks up item named \"amex\" (override with AMEX_BW_ITEM).\n     Requires BW_SESSION to be set. To get one:\n         export BW_SESSION=\"$(bw unlock --raw)\"\n\nSupported Bitwarden item types:\n  - Login (type 1): returns (login.username, login.password)\n  - Card  (type 3): returns (card.number, custom_field \"passcode\")\n                    The passcode field on a Card item is the CVV (3-4 digits),\n                    not the online banking passcode — so the latter must live\n                    in a custom field. Add one named exactly \"passcode\".\n\nReturns (username, password) or (None, None) if nothing resolved.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport subprocess\n\nBW_TYPE_LOGIN = 1\nBW_TYPE_CARD = 3\n\n\ndef get_credentials(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    upper = provider.upper()\n\n    u = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_USERNAME\")\n    p = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_PASSWORD\")\n    if u and p:\n        return u, p\n\n    item_name = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_BW_ITEM\", provider)\n    return _from_bitwarden(item_name)\n\n\ndef _from_bitwarden(item_name: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    session = os.environ.get(\"BW_SESSION\")\n    if not session:\n        return None, None\n\n    try:\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [\"bw\", \"get\", \"item\", item_name, \"--session\", session],\n            capture_output=True,\n            text=True,\n            timeout=15,\n        )\n    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):\n        return None, None\n\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        return None, None\n\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(result.stdout)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return None, None\n\n    item_type = data.get(\"type\")\n    if item_type == BW_TYPE_LOGIN:\n        login = (data.get(\"login\") or {})\n        return login.get(\"username\"), login.get(\"password\")\n\n    if item_type == BW_TYPE_CARD:\n        card = (data.get(\"card\") or {})\n        number = card.get(\"number\")\n        passcode = _custom_field(data, \"passcode\")\n        return number, passcode\n\n    return None, None\n\n\ndef _custom_field(item: dict, name: str) -> str | None:\n    for field in (item.get(\"fields\") or []):\n        if (field.get(\"name\") or \"\").strip().lower() == name.lower():\n            return field.get(\"value\")\n    return None"

Prefer exact name matches, then Login type, then Card type.\n    exact = [i for i in items if (i.get(\"name\") or \"\").strip() == item_name]\n    pool = exact or items\n\n    for wanted in (BW_TYPE_LOGIN, BW_TYPE_CARD):\n        for item in pool:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == wanted:\n                return _extract(item)\n\n    return None, None\n\n\ndef _extract(item: dict) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    t = item.get(\"type\")\n    if t == BW_TYPE_LOGIN:\n        login = (item.get(\"login\") or {})\n        return login.get(\"username\"), login.get(\"password\")\n    if t == BW_TYPE_CARD:\n        card = (item.get(\"card\") or {})\n        return card.get(\"number\"), _custom_field(item, \"passcode\")\n    return None, None\n\n\ndef _bw_run(cmd: list[str]) -> dict | list | None:\n    try:\n        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)\n    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):\n        return None\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return json.loads(result.stdout)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef _custom_field(item: dict, name: str) -> str | None:\n    for field in (item.get(\"fields\") or []):\n        if (field.get(\"name\") or \"\").strip().lower() == name.lower():\n            return field.get(\"value\")\n    return None"

1. **Always open a new page** instead of reusing the restored tab
2. **Close any other open tabs** the context restored

  "new_string": "async def dismiss_cookie_banner(page: Page, extra: Iterable[str] = ()) -> None:\n    selectors = list(extra) + COOKIE_SELECTORS\n    for sel in selectors:\n        try:\n            loc = page.locator(sel).first\n            if await loc.is_visible(timeout=1500):\n                await loc.click(timeout=3000)\n                print(f\"  dismissed cookie banner via: {sel}\")\n                await page.wait_for_timeout(500)\n                return\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n\n    # Shadow-DOM fallback for Tealium / similar custom-element banners.\n    # CSS/text selectors can't pierce a closed shadow root, but plain JS can\n    # access an open one; failing that, we just remove the banner element.\n    js = \"\"\"() => {\n        const tags = ['tealium-consent', 'tealium-banner'];\n        for (const t of tags) {\n            const el = document.querySelector(t);\n            if (el && el.shadowRoot) {\n                const btns = el.shadowRoot.querySelectorAll('button, a[role=\"button\"]');\n                for (const b of btns) {\n                    if (/accept/i.test((b.textContent || '').trim())) { b.click(); return 'clicked:' + t; }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        const modal = document.getElementById('__tealiumGDPRecModal')\n                   || document.querySelector('tealium-consent')\n                   || document.querySelector('[id*=\"cookie\" i][role=\"dialog\"]');\n        if (modal) { modal.remove(); return 'removed'; }\n        return null;\n    }\"\"\"\n    try:\n        result = await page.evaluate(js)\n        if result:\n            print(f\"  dismissed cookie banner via JS: {result}\")\n            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)\n    except Exception:\n        pass"
}

{

  "old_string": "def get_credentials(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    upper = provider.upper()\n\n    u = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_USERNAME\")\n    p = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_PASSWORD\")\n    if u and p:\n        return u, p\n\n    item_name = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_BW_ITEM\", provider)\n    return _from_bitwarden(item_name)",
  "new_string": "def get_credentials(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    upper = provider.upper()\n\n    u = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_USERNAME\")\n    p = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_PASSWORD\")\n    if u and p:\n        return u, p\n\n    item_name = os.environ.get(f\"{upper}_BW_ITEM\", provider)\n    return _from_bitwarden(item_name)\n\n\ndef get_card(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Return (card_number, cvv) for a provider's Card item in Bitwarden.\"\"\"\n    session = os.environ.get(\"BW_SESSION\")\n    if not session:\n        return None, None\n    item_name = os.environ.get(f\"{provider.upper()}_BW_CARD_ITEM\", provider)\n    items = _bw_run([\"bw\", \"list\", \"items\", \"--search\", item_name, \"--session\", session])\n    if not isinstance(items, list):\n        return None, None\n    cards = [i for i in items if i.get(\"type\") == BW_TYPE_CARD]\n    if not cards:\n        return None, None\n    exact = [i for i in cards if (i.get(\"name\") or \"\").strip() == item_name]\n    card = (exact or cards)[0].get(\"card\") or {}\n    return card.get(\"number\"), card.get(\"code\")"
}

  "new_string": "async def _toggle(loc, force: bool) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Try .check() (for real checkboxes) then .click() (for labels / wrappers).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        await loc.check(timeout=3000, force=force)\n        return\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    await loc.click(timeout=3000, force=force)\n\n\nasync def first_visible_check(page: Page, selectors: Iterable[str], label: str) -> bool:\n    for sel in selectors:\n        try:\n            loc = page.locator(sel).first\n            if await loc.is_visible(timeout=1500):\n                await _toggle(loc, force=True)\n                print(f\"  ticked {label} via: {sel}\")\n                return True\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    # Fallback: any attached element, forced.\n    for sel in selectors:\n        try:\n            loc = page.locator(sel).first\n            await loc.wait_for(state=\"attached\", timeout=1500)\n            await _toggle(loc, force=True)\n            print(f\"  ticked {label} via: {sel} (force)\")\n            return True\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    return False"
}

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/scrapers/creds.py",
  "old_string": "def _custom_field(item: dict, name: str) -> str | None:\n    for field in (item.get(\"fields\") or []):\n        if (field.get(\"name\") or \"\").strip().lower() == name.lower():\n            return field.get(\"value\")\n    return None",
  "new_string": "def _norm(s: str | None) -> str:\n    return \"\".join(c.lower() for c in (s or \"\") if c.isalnum())\n\n\ndef _custom_field(item: dict, name: str) -> str | None:\n    target = _norm(name)\n    for field in (item.get(\"fields\") or []):\n        if _norm(field.get(\"name\")) == target:\n            return field.get(\"value\")\n    return None\n\n\ndef get_custom_field(provider: str, field_name: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Look up a Bitwarden custom field on any item matching the provider name.\n    Field-name match is fuzzy: ignores case, spaces, underscores, hyphens.\"\"\"\n    session = os.environ.get(\"BW_SESSION\")\n    if not session:\n        return None\n    item_name = os.environ.get(f\"{provider.upper()}_BW_ITEM\", provider)\n    items = _bw_run([\"bw\", \"list\", \"items\", \"--search\", item_name, \"--session\", session])\n    if not isinstance(items, list):\n        return None\n    # Prefer Login item, then Card.\n    for wanted in (BW_TYPE_LOGIN, BW_TYPE_CARD):\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") != wanted:\n                continue\n            val = _custom_field(item, field_name)\n            if val:\n                return val\n    return None"
}

> AGENT

Should be ~3× faster:
- Selector visibility timeouts: 1500ms → 500ms (the biggest gain — each unmatched selector costs 1/3 as much)
- Inter-page waits: 2000ms → 700ms (Barclaycard's SPA transitions in ~400ms typically)
- Final wait: 2500ms → 1000ms

Trade-off: if a slow network makes a field appear after 500ms, the visible-pass will miss it and fall through to the force-pass — still works, just one extra cycle. Acceptable.

Try:

```bash
python -m scrapers.barclaycard --headed
```

1	"""
2	Barclaycard UK scraper — first slice.
3	
4	Goal: prove login + persistent-session pattern. Download flow gets wired in
5	after we see what the post-login dashboard looks like.
6	
7	Usage:
8	    python -m scrapers.barclaycard --headed       # first run, browser opens
9	    python -m scrapers.barclaycard                 # subsequent runs, headless
10	
11	Credentials:
12	    BARCLAYCARD_USERNAME + BARCLAYCARD_PASSWORD env vars, OR
13	    Bitwarden item "barclaycard" (override with BARCLAYCARD_BW_ITEM).
14	    The login may also ask for characters from a memorable word — for now
15	    complete that step manually in the open browser on first login.
16	
17	Output:
18	    ~/.argus/finance/profiles/barclaycard/
19	    ~/.argus/finance/raw/barclaycard/
20	"""
21	
22	import argparse
23	import asyncio
24	import re
25	import sys
26	
27	from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeout
28	
29	from scrapers import _common as common
30	from scrapers.creds import get_card, get_credentials, get_custom_field
31	
32	PROVIDER = "barclaycard"
33	LOGIN_URL = "https://bcol.barclaycard.co.uk/as3/UI/#/login/"
34	
35	PROFILE_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR = common.paths(PROVIDER)
36	
37	# Best-guess selectors — will be refined after first run dumps state.
38	USER_FIELDS = [
39	    "#usernameAndID",
40	    'input[name="usernameAndID"]',
41	    "#loginId",
42	    "#username",
43	    "#memberId",
44	    'input[name="username"]',
45	    'input[name="loginId"]',
46	    'input[name="memberId"]',
47	    'input[autocomplete="username"]',
48	]
49	PASSWORD_FIELDS = [
50	    "#passcode",
51	    "#password",
52	    'input[name="passcode"]',
53	    'input[name="password"]',
54	    'input[type="password"]',
55	    'input[autocomplete="current-password"]',
56	]
57	CARD_NUMBER_FIELDS = [
58	    "#cardNumber",
59	    "#card-number",
60	    'input[name="cardNumber"]',
61	    'input[name="card-number"]',
62	    'input[autocomplete="cc-number"]',
63	    'input[inputmode="numeric"][maxlength="16"]',
64	]
65	LOGIN_BUTTON_EXTRA = [
66	    'button:has-text("Continue")',
67	    'button:has-text("Log in")',
68	    'button:has-text("Log In")',
69	]
70	
71	
72	def _looks_logged_in(url: str) -> bool:
73	    lower = url.lower()
74	    if any(x in lower for x in ("login", "logon", "identity", "verify", "otp", "challenge", "auth")):
75	        return False
76	    return any(x in lower for x in ("home", "dashboard", "summary", "overview", "account", "transactions"))
77	
78	
79	async def run(headed: bool) -> int:
80	    stamp = common.now_stamp()
81	
82	    async with async_playwright() as p:
83	        ctx = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
84	            user_data_dir=str(PROFILE_DIR),
85	            headless=not headed,
86	            accept_downloads=True,
87	            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900},
88	        )
89	        # Discard any tabs the persistent context restored from a previous session
90	        # (e.g. a Google search page) — always start on a fresh page.
91	        for existing in list(ctx.pages):
92	            try:
93	                await existing.close()
94	            except Exception:
95	                pass
96	        page = await ctx.new_page()
97	
98	        try:
99	            await page.goto(LOGIN_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30_000)
100	        except PlaywrightTimeout:
101	            print("Initial navigation timed out.")
102	            return 1
103	
104	        # SPA — wait for JS to settle before looking for form fields.
105	        try:
106	            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=15_000)
107	        except PlaywrightTimeout:
108	            print("Network never went idle — proceeding anyway.")
109	
110	        await common.dismiss_cookie_banner(page)
111	
112	        # Always dump initial state so we can see what loaded, even on success.
113	        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "entry")
114	        print(f"Initial page captured: {stamp}_entry.png / .html")
115	
116	        if not _looks_logged_in(page.url):
117	            await interactive_login(page, stamp)
118	            timeout = 600_000 if headed else 30_000
119	            try:
120	                await page.wait_for_url(_looks_logged_in, timeout=timeout)
121	            except PlaywrightTimeout:
122	                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "post_login_stuck")
123	                if not headed:
124	                    print(
125	                        "Headless re-login didn't clear within 30s — likely an OTP/memorable-word "
126	                        "prompt. Re-run with --headed."
127	                    )
128	                print(f"Final URL: {page.url}")
129	                return 3
130	
131	        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=30_000)
132	        print(f"Landed on: {page.url}")
133	        shot, html = await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "landed")
134	        print(f"Screenshot: {shot}")
135	        print(f"HTML dump:  {html}")
136	
137	        await ctx.close()
138	        return 0
139	
140	
141	async def interactive_login(page, stamp: str) -> None:
142	    username, password = get_credentials(PROVIDER)
143	    if not (username and password):
144	        print(f"No credentials resolved for '{PROVIDER}' (env or Bitwarden item).")
145	        print("  → fill the login form manually in the open browser.")
146	        return
147	
148	    print("Filling credentials...")
149	    filled_user = await common.first_visible_fill(page, USER_FIELDS, username, "user")
150	    if not filled_user:
151	        for label in ("Username", "User ID", "Membership number", "Member ID"):
152	            try:
153	                await page.get_by_label(label, exact=False).first.fill(username, timeout=3000)
154	                filled_user = True
155	                print(f"  filled user via label: {label!r}")
156	                break
157	            except Exception:
158	                continue
159	
160	    # Page 1: username + Remember Me → Next
161	    if filled_user:
162	        await common.tick_remember_me(page)
163	        await common.click_login_button(page, LOGIN_BUTTON_EXTRA)
164	        await page.wait_for_timeout(700)
165	
166	    # Page 2: card number → Next
167	    card_number, _cvv = get_card(PROVIDER)
168	    if card_number:
169	        if await common.first_visible_fill(page, CARD_NUMBER_FIELDS, card_number, "card number"):
170	            await common.click_login_button(page, LOGIN_BUTTON_EXTRA)
171	            await page.wait_for_timeout(700)
172	    else:
173	        print("  no card number from Bitwarden — fill it manually if prompted")
174	
175	    # Page 3: passcode + memorable word → Next
176	    await common.first_visible_fill(page, PASSWORD_FIELDS, password, "passcode")
177	
178	    memorable_word = get_custom_field(PROVIDER, "memorable_word")
179	    if memorable_word:
180	        await fill_memorable_word(page, memorable_word)
181	    else:
182	        print('  no "memorable_word" custom field in Bitwarden — fill it manually')
183	
184	    await common.click_login_button(page, LOGIN_BUTTON_EXTRA)
185	    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
186	    await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "after_submit")
187	
188	    print()
189	    print("If Barclaycard prompts for memorable-word characters, OTP, or app approval,")
190	    print("complete it in the open browser. Waiting up to 10 minutes for dashboard.")
191	
192	
193	async def fill_memorable_word(page, word: str) -> int:
194	    """Read each "Nth letter" prompt on the page and type the corresponding
195	    character from the stored memorable word. Returns the count filled."""
196	    inputs = await page.locator('[data-testid^="memorableWord-letter"]').all()
197	    if not inputs:
198	        return 0
199	
200	    filled = 0
201	    for inp in inputs:
202	        input_id = await inp.get_attribute("id")
203	        label_text = ""
204	        if input_id:
205	            try:
206	                label_text = (await page.locator(f'label[for="{input_id}"]').first.text_content() or "").strip()
207	            except Exception:
208	                pass
209	        m = re.match(r"(\d+)", label_text)
210	        if not m:
211	            continue
212	        pos = int(m.group(1))
213	        if pos < 1 or pos > len(word):
214	            print(f"  memorable word: position {pos} out of range for stored word")
215	            continue
216	        char = word[pos - 1]
217	        try:
218	            await inp.fill(char, force=True)
219	            print(f"  filled memorable word letter {pos}")
220	            filled += 1
221	        except Exception as e:
222	            print(f"  failed to fill letter {pos}: {e}")
223	    return filled
224	
225	
226	def main() -> int:
227	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
228	    parser.add_argument("--headed", action="store_true", help="Show the browser window.")
229	    args = parser.parse_args()
230	    return asyncio.run(run(headed=common.auto_headed(PROFILE_DIR, args.headed)))
231	
232	
233	if __name__ == "__main__":
234	    sys.exit(main())

Classic React/SPA issue — `fill()` sets the value but doesn't fire the keystroke events the form listens to, so its internal state thinks the field is still empty. Switching to `press_sequentially` which simulates real typing.

  "new_string": "        char = word[pos - 1]\n        try:\n            # Simulate real typing — React/Angular forms ignore .fill() value\n            # changes unless keystroke events fire. SPA fields sometimes\n    # report as not-visible (opacity transitions, off-screen) but accept input.\n    for sel in selectors:\n        try:\n            loc = page.locator(sel).first\n            await loc.wait_for(state=\"attached\", timeout=500)\n            await loc.fill(value, timeout=5000, force=True)\n            print(f\"  filled {label} via: {sel} (force)\")\n            return True\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    return False",
  "new_string": "async def _type_into(loc, value: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Type value into the located element with proper keystroke events.\n    React/Angular forms ignore .fill() unless keystroke events fire.\"\"\"\n    await loc.click()\n    await loc.fill(\"\")\n    await loc.press_sequentially(value, delay=10)\n\n\nasync def first_visible_fill(page: Page, selectors: Iterable[str], value: str, label: str) -> bool:\n    # First pass: visible elements (preferred — proves the field is interactable).\n    for sel in selectors:\n        try:\n            loc = page.locator(sel).first\n            if await loc.is_visible(timeout=500):\n                await _type_into(loc, value)\n                print(f\"  filled {label} via: {sel}\")\n                return True\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    # Second pass: any attached element with a forced fill. Changes:
- Each step waits for **one specific selector** (e.g. `#cardNumber`) to be visible, then immediately types — no multi-selector hunt, no fallback timeouts
- `wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)` returns the moment the field appears (typically <500ms for this SPA)
- `press_sequentially` delay reduced from 10ms → 5ms (16-digit card now types in 80ms instead of 160ms)
- Remember-me uses the known `#rememberMe` directly, falls back to label click if that fails
- `Next` button clicked via `get_by_role` for cleaner semantics

- Card-number skipped → log "device trusted", continue straight to passcode

> AGENT

CSV looks great — 33 transactions for the May 2026 statement, format:

```
Date, Description, CardType, Cardholder, Category, Credit, Debit
10 May 26, "eBay O*08-...", Visa, MR S SAINI, Shopping, , 16.10
08 May 26, "Payment By Direct Debit", n/a, MR S SAINI, , -359.17,
```

Bonus stuff that Amex didn't give:
- Inline FX breakdown for foreign txns (`59.00 EURO NETHERLANDS Transaction Fee £1.53`)
- Pre-categorised (Shopping, Leisure, Groceries, Travel, etc.)
- Cardholder name (useful if you ever add another cardholder)

Quirks vs Amex:
- **No reference ID** — we'll need to dedupe on `(date + description + debit + credit)` instead. Should be unique enough in practice.
- **Two amount columns** — Credit and Debit (Amex was one signed column)

Barclaycard is done end-to-end. Which bank next?

Hit a CAPTCHA — "click on the TWO identical shapes". That's Revolut's bot detection firing because Playwright's Chromium fingerprint looks bot-like to them. Two implications:

1. **First login**: solve the CAPTCHA manually in the open browser. After that, fill the passcode manually too (we'll add passcode automation once we see the field).
2. **Persistent question**: does this CAPTCHA appear again on subsequent runs once we have a session, or every single time? If every time, automation isn't viable without `playwright-stealth` or a CAPTCHA-solving service.

For now: solve the CAPTCHA + complete login manually in the open browser, get to the dashboard, and we capture state. Then we test headless next time to see if CAPTCHA recurs.

python -m scrapers.revolut --headed
```

hmm very strange seems like it's blicking the sign in it's saying my details are incorrect but they are not if I open a new window and do it myself. The captcha is every time

> AGENT

That's a stronger signal than the CAPTCHA alone — Revolut is silently rejecting auth from anything that looks like an automated browser, returning a "wrong credentials" error to hide the real reason. This is industrial-grade bot detection (probably DataDome or Akamai). The CAPTCHA is the visible bit; the silent reject is the hidden bit.

You can't beat this from inside a vanilla Playwright Chromium. Three options, increasing painfulness:

**1. `playwright-stealth` (cheap try, might not work)** — a Python package that patches Chromium's runtime to hide common automation tells (`navigator.webdriver`, missing plugin counts, etc.). Sometimes gets past DataDome, often doesn't. ~10 mins to plug in.

**2. Drive your real Chrome via CDP** — instead of launching a fresh Chromium, attach to your actual Chrome (launched with `--remote-debugging-port=9222`). The fingerprint is then a real Chrome, real OS, real GPU, real fonts. Much harder to detect. Setup is fiddlier — you'd start Chrome manually once, the scraper connects.

**3. Skip Revolut automation entirely.** Revolut's web app is explicitly not their priority — their stance is "use the mobile app." Pragmatic answer: once a month, manually export the CSV from the Revolut mobile app and drop it into `~/.argus/finance/raw/revolut/`. Argus's ingest pipeline reads from that folder regardless of how the file got there.

Honest take: **option 3 is what I'd actually do** for one user, one month between exports, given Revolut's whole stack is designed to make 1 and 2 a constant arms race. The other 7 banks give you near-real-time data — Revolut once a month is fine to fill in.

But you decide. Want me to try `playwright-stealth` first? Or skip Revolut and move to Aqua/Nationwide?

Is ther no API for revolute?

> AGENT

For Revolut specifically:

- **Revolut Business** — yes, full free API with OAuth, gives you balances + transactions + statements. If you have a Business account this is the clean answer.
- **Revolut Personal** — no public API. Their stance: use the mobile app. The "Open Banking API" they mention in dev docs is only for regulated TPPs (same wall we hit with other banks).
- **iOS Shortcuts** — Revolut has some Shortcut actions but they're for triggering payments, not for reading data into a server.
- **Email statements** — you can have Revolut email you monthly statements (PDF/CSV) in account settings. Free, no automation needed, runs forever.

If you only have a personal account, the realistic options are:
1. **Email statement subscription** → Argus reads the statement email each month. Less real-time but fully automatic. This is actually pretty clean.
2. **Manual monthly export** from the app.

Do you have Revolut Business, or just Personal? And if Personal — want me to look into the email-statement approach?

> DEVELOPER

I do have a business account but also a personal.

> AGENT

OK that splits clean:

**Revolut Business — proper API.** Free, official, gives you `/accounts`, `/transactions` (filterable by date, paginated), works headlessly forever. Auth is a one-time setup: generate a self-signed cert in Revolut Business dashboard, upload the public key, and we sign each API call with the private key. No OAuth dance needed for self-use. ~30 min of setup, then it Just Works.

**Revolut Personal — email statements.** In the personal app: Account → Statements → enable monthly delivery. Argus reads the email when it arrives (PDF or CSV depending on settings — CSV is what we want). Fully automatic, runs forever, no scraping.

I'd do both in parallel and they live in `~/.argus/finance/raw/revolut/` either way (one subfolder for business, one for personal).

  "new_string": "async def interactive_login(page, stamp: str) -> None:\n    username, password = get_credentials(PROVIDER)\n    if not (username and password):\n        print(f\"No credentials resolved for '{PROVIDER}' — fill the form manually.\")\n        return\n\n    print(\"Filling credentials...\")\n\n    # Step 1: Customer number + Date of birth + Remember me + Continue\n    try:\n        await page.locator('input[name=\"CustomerNumber\"][type=\"text\"]').wait_for(state=\"visible\", timeout=5_000)\n        await common.type_into(page.locator('input[name=\"CustomerNumber\"][type=\"text\"]'), username)\n        print(\"  filled customer number\")\n    except Exception:\n        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"no_user_field\")\n        print(\"  could not find customer number field — see screenshot\")\n        return\n\n    dob_raw = get_custom_field(PROVIDER, \"date_of_birth\") or get_custom_field(PROVIDER, \"dob\")\n    if dob_raw:\n        day, month_name, year = _parse_dob(dob_raw)\n        if day and month_name and year:\n            await common.type_into(page.locator('input[name=\"DateOfBirthDay\"]'), day)\n            await page.locator('select[name=\"DateOfBirthMonth\"]').select_option(label=month_name)\n            await common.type_into(page.locator('input[name=\"DateOfBirthYear\"]'), year)\n            print(f\"  filled DOB: {day} {month_name} {year}\")\n        else:\n            print(f\"  could not parse DOB '{dob_raw}' — expected DD/MM/YYYY\")\n    else:\n        print('  no \"date_of_birth\" custom field in Bitwarden — fill it manually')\n\n    try:\n        await page.locator('input[type=\"checkbox\"][name=\"RememberMe\"]').check(force=True)\n        print(\"  ticked remember-me\")\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n\n    await page.locator(\"button.action__button:has-text('Continue')\").first.click()\n\n    # Step 2: Memorable data / passnumber. May be one field or partial chars —\n    # we'll find out from a dump if this fails.\n    try:\n        await page.locator('input[type=\"password\"], input[name*=\"memorable\" i], input[name*=\"passnumber\" i]').first.wait_for(state=\"visible\", timeout=8_000)\n    except PlaywrightTimeout:\n        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"no_step2_field\")\n        print(\"  step 2 fields didn't appear — see screenshot\")\n        return\n\n    if not await common.first_visible_fill(\n        page,\n        ['input[name*=\"memorable\" i]', 'input[name*=\"passnumber\" i]', 'input[type=\"password\"]'],\n        password,\n        \"memorable data\",\n    ):\n        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"no_password_field\")\n        print(\"  could not fill memorable data — see screenshot, finish manually\")\n        return\n\n    await common.click_login_button(page)\n    print()\n    print(\"If Nationwide prompts for OTP / app approval, complete it in the open browser.\")\n    print(\"Waiting up to 10 minutes for the dashboard to load.\")\n\n\ndef _parse_dob(raw: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Parse DD/MM/YYYY (or DD-MM-YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY) into (day, month_name, year).\n    Also accepts YYYY-MM-DD.\"\"\"\n    raw = raw.strip()\n    # YYYY-MM-DD\n    m = re.match(r\"^(\\d{4})[-/.](\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{1,2})$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        year, mm, dd = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3).zfill(2)\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    # DD/MM/YYYY\n    m = re.match(r\"^(\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{4})$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        dd, mm, year = m.group(1).zfill(2), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    return None, None, None"

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/scrapers/nationwide.py",
  "old_string": "def _parse_dob(raw: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Parse DD/MM/YYYY (or DD-MM-YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY) into (day, month_name, year).\n    Also accepts YYYY-MM-DD.\"\"\"\n    raw = raw.strip()\n    # YYYY-MM-DD\n    m = re.match(r\"^(\\d{4})[-/.](\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{1,2})$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        year, mm, dd = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3).zfill(2)\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    # DD/MM/YYYY\n    m = re.match(r\"^(\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{4})$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        dd, mm, year = m.group(1).zfill(2), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    return None, None, None",
  "new_string": "def _parse_dob(raw: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Parse various DOB formats into (day, month_name, year).\n    Accepts DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, DDMMYY, DDMMYYYY.\"\"\"\n    raw = raw.strip()\n    # YYYY-MM-DD\n    m = re.match(r\"^(\\d{4})[-/.](\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{1,2})$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        year, mm, dd = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3).zfill(2)\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    # DD/MM/YYYY with separator\n    m = re.match(r\"^(\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{1,2})[-/.](\\d{4})$\", raw)\n    if m:\n        dd, mm, year = m.group(1).zfill(2), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    # DDMMYYYY no separator (8 digits)\n    if raw.isdigit() and len(raw) == 8:\n        dd, mm, year = raw[0:2], int(raw[2:4]), raw[4:8]\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    # DDMMYY no separator (6 digits) — pivot: 00-30 → 20YY, 31-99 → 19YY\n    if raw.isdigit() and len(raw) == 6:\n        dd, mm, yy = raw[0:2], int(raw[2:4]), int(raw[4:6])\n        if 1 <= mm <= 12:\n            year = f\"20{yy:02d}\" if yy <= 30 else f\"19{yy:02d}\"\n            return dd, MONTHS[mm - 1], year\n    return None, None, None"
}

What do you think is best for this. I am happy to do passcode and OTP but then this sytem is no longer automated is it...

> AGENT

Fair concern, but it's the same situation as Amex — and Amex turned out fine. The question isn't "do I do 2FA?", it's **"does the trust-device cookie persist after I do 2FA once?"**

Recap with Amex:
- First headed login → did OTP manually
- Ticked "remember this device"
- Next headless run 24h later → cookie was trusted, **no OTP needed**, downloaded CSV silently
- Cron-viable

The whole automation lives on that one cookie persisting. Whether you do app-tap, passcode+OTP, or card reader is irrelevant — the question is what comes *after* you finish.

What I'd do:
1. Pick **passcode + OTP** (the most likely path to have a "remember this device" toggle somewhere)
2. **Look closely after the OTP** for any "Don't ask again on this device" / "Remember this device" checkbox — tick it
3. Land on dashboard
4. Run again headless tomorrow — if it slides through, automation works forever (until the cookie eventually expires, which is the same problem every bank has)

If Nationwide *doesn't* offer trusted-device persistence at all (i.e., it asks 2FA every login regardless), then yes — we're stuck. The realistic answer for that case would be SMS-OTP forwarding (Android Tasker thing we discussed), which you said leave for now. The fallback is downloading the statement CSV monthly when you log in manually anyway.

But we don't know yet. **Do the manual 2FA once, tick whatever "trust device" option appears, then we test headless tomorrow to see if it persisted.** That's the only way to find out.

App confirmation might also persist — but trust-device prompts more often appear on the SMS/passcode path. Go passcode+OTP if you can.

The radio is visually hidden behind\n    # a styled label, so force-check it and dispatch a change event so the\n    # data-pl framework swaps in the right form.\n    picked = False\n    try:\n        await page.locator('input[name=\"SelectedLoginRoute\"][value=\"PassNumberAndSMSOTP\"]').check(force=True, timeout=5000)\n        await page.evaluate(\"\"\"() => {\n            const r = document.querySelector('input[name=\"SelectedLoginRoute\"][value=\"PassNumberAndSMSOTP\"]');\n            if (r) {\n                r.checked = true;\n                r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));\n                r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));\n            }\n        }\"\"\")\n        print(\"  picked Passnumber+SMS radio\")\n        picked = True\n    except Exception:\n        try:\n            await page.locator('label:has-text(\"Passnumber and code by text\")').first.click(force=True, timeout=5000)\n            print(\"  picked Passnumber+SMS via label\")\n            picked = True\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"  failed: {e}\")\n    if not picked:\n        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"no_2fa_method\")\n        print('  could not auto-pick \"Passnumber + SMS\" — pick the tab manually.')"
}

  "new_string": "    # Fill the requested passnumber digits. The page asks for 3 of the 6\n    # digits (e.g., \"1st, 2nd and 4th\"). Each dropdown's label says which.\n    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)\n    filled_digits = await fill_passnumber_digits(page, password)\n    if filled_digits:\n        print(f\"  filled {filled_digits} passnumber digits\")\n    else:\n        print(\"  no passnumber dropdowns found (or pass len wrong) — fill them manually\")\n\n    print()\n    print(\"Now wait for the SMS, type the code in the open browser, and submit.\")\n    print(\"LOOK FOR a 'Remember this device' / 'Don't ask again' toggle and TICK IT — that's the\")\n    print(\"only thing standing between us and unattended cron working.\")\n    print(\"Waiting up to 10 minutes for the dashboard to load.\")\n\n\n_ORDINAL = {\n    \"first\": 1, \"second\": 2, \"third\": 3, \"fourth\": 4, \"fifth\": 5, \"sixth\": 6,\n    \"seventh\": 7, \"eighth\": 8, \"ninth\": 9, \"tenth\": 10,\n}\n\n\nasync def fill_passnumber_digits(page, passnumber: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Fill Nationwide's 'select the Nth digit of your passnumber' dropdowns.\n    Each dropdown's screen-reader label says which position is needed.\"\"\"\n    labels = await page.locator('label[for^=\"selection-list-control\"]').all()\n    if not labels:\n        return 0\n\n    filled = 0\n    for label in labels:\n        text = (await label.text_content() or \"\").lower()\n        m = re.search(r\"select the (\\w+) digit\", text)\n        if not m:\n            continue\n        pos = _ORDINAL.get(m.group(1))\n        if not pos or pos < 1 or pos > len(passnumber):\n            continue\n        digit = passnumber[pos - 1]\n        for_attr = await label.get_attribute(\"for\")\n        if not for_attr:\n            continue\n        select = page.locator(f'select[id=\"{for_attr}\"]')\n        try:\n            await select.select_option(label=digit)\n            print(f\"  filled digit {pos}: '{digit}'\")\n            filled += 1\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"  failed to fill digit {pos}: {e}\")\n    return filled"
}

About **midata** — yes, it's worth knowing about:
- UK government scheme. Banks are legally required to give you a year of transaction history in a standardised CSV format
- Nationwide supports it, usually labelled "Midata download" somewhere on the site
- The CSV has 5 fields: Date, Type, Merchant/Description, Debit/Credit, Balance
- **Major advantage**: standardised across banks (same columns from Nationwide, Lloyds, NatWest, etc.) — easier to write one parser
- Trade-off: only updates once a year (frozen snapshot) and limited to 12 months

For our use case, the **regular "Download transactions"** (date-range CSV) is better for ongoing scraping — fresher data, daily updates. Midata could be a useful one-off backfill if you want to load historical data when first setting up.

Run the script and we'll see what format options the download page exposes — could be CSV / OFX / QIF / midata all in one place.

{
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/scrapers/revolut.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"\nRevolut UK scraper — login is manual (bot detection), nav + download automated.\n\nApproach: open the persistent browser. If not already logged in, wait for\nthe user to sign in by hand (phone → CAPTCHA → passcode → 2FA). Once landed\non the dashboard, the script handles the rest — navigation to transactions\nand CSV download.\n\nAfter the first manual login, the persistent profile cookies may keep us\nauthenticated for subsequent runs, so they get faster over time.\n\nUsage:\n    python -m scrapers.revolut --headed     # first run, sign in manually\n    python -m scrapers.revolut               # try silent run with saved session\n\nOutput:\n    ~/.argus/finance/profiles/revolut/\n    ~/.argus/finance/raw/revolut/\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport asyncio\nimport sys\n\nfrom playwright.async_api import async_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeout\nfrom playwright_stealth import Stealth\n\nfrom scrapers import _common as common\n\nPROVIDER = \"revolut\"\nLOGIN_URL = \"https://app.revolut.com/start\"\nHOME_URL = \"https://app.revolut.com/home\"\n\nPROFILE_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR = common.paths(PROVIDER)\n\n\ndef _looks_logged_in(url: str) -> bool:\n    lower = url.lower()\n    if any(x in lower for x in (\"start\", \"signin\", \"sign-in\", \"login\", \"auth\", \"verify\", \"challenge\")):\n        return False\n    return \"app.revolut.com\" in lower\n\n\nasync def run(headed: bool) -> int:\n    stamp = common.now_stamp()\n\n    async with Stealth().use_async(async_playwright()) as p:\n        ctx = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(\n            user_data_dir=str(PROFILE_DIR),\n            headless=not headed,\n            accept_downloads=True,\n            viewport={\"width\": 1400, \"height\": 900},\n        )\n        for existing in list(ctx.pages):\n            try:\n                await existing.close()\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n        page = await ctx.new_page()\n\n        try:\n            await page.goto(HOME_URL, wait_until=\"domcontentloaded\", timeout=30_000)\n        except PlaywrightTimeout:\n            print(\"Initial navigation timed out.\")\n            return 1\n\n        await common.dismiss_cookie_banner(page)\n\n        if not _looks_logged_in(page.url):\n            if not headed:\n                print(\"Not logged in and running headless. Re-run with --headed and sign in.\")\n                return 2\n            print()\n            print(\"Sign in manually in the open browser:\")\n            print(\"  phone → CAPTCHA → passcode → 2FA approval in your phone app\")\n            print(\"Waiting up to 10 minutes for you to land on the dashboard.\")\n            try:\n                await page.wait_for_url(_looks_logged_in, timeout=600_000)\n            except PlaywrightTimeout:\n                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"post_login_stuck\")\n                print(f\"Didn't land on dashboard within 10 min. Final URL: {page.url}\")\n                return 3\n\n        await page.wait_for_load_state(\"networkidle\", timeout=30_000)\n        print(f\"Landed on: {page.url}\")\n        shot, html = await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"landed\")\n        print(f\"Landed dump: {html}\")\n\n        await ctx.close()\n        return 0\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--headed\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Show the browser window.\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    return asyncio.run(run(headed=common.auto_headed(PROFILE_DIR, args.headed)))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"\nRevolut UK scraper.\n\nBot detection prevents fully automated login, but the script can still fill\nyour phone + passcode from Bitwarden and click through the steps — leaving\nyou to do just the CAPTCHA and 2FA approval. After first login the persistent\nprofile may keep you signed in.\n\nUsage:\n    python -m scrapers.revolut --headed     # first run, complete CAPTCHA + 2FA\n    python -m scrapers.revolut               # try silent run with saved session\n\nCredentials:\n    Bitwarden Login item \"revolut\" (override with REVOLUT_BW_ITEM):\n      Username = phone number (international format, e.g. +447xxxxxxxxx)\n      Password = 6-digit Revolut passcode\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport asyncio\nimport sys\n\nfrom playwright.async_api import async_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeout\nfrom playwright_stealth import Stealth\n\nfrom scrapers import _common as common\nfrom scrapers.creds import get_credentials\n\nPROVIDER = \"revolut\"\nLOGIN_URL = \"https://app.revolut.com/start\"\nHOME_URL = \"https://app.revolut.com/home\"\n\nPROFILE_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR = common.paths(PROVIDER)\n\n\ndef _looks_logged_in(url: str) -> bool:\n    lower = url.lower()\n    if any(x in lower for x in (\"start\", \"signin\", \"sign-in\", \"login\", \"auth\", \"verify\", \"challenge\")):\n        return False\n    return \"app.revolut.com\" in lower\n\n\nasync def run(headed: bool) -> int:\n    stamp = common.now_stamp()\n\n    async with Stealth().use_async(async_playwright()) as p:\n        ctx = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(\n            user_data_dir=str(PROFILE_DIR),\n            headless=not headed,\n            accept_downloads=True,\n            viewport={\"width\": 1400, \"height\": 900},\n        )\n        for existing in list(ctx.pages):\n            try:\n                await existing.close()\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n        page = await ctx.new_page()\n\n        try:\n            await page.goto(HOME_URL, wait_until=\"domcontentloaded\", timeout=30_000)\n        except PlaywrightTimeout:\n            print(\"Initial navigation timed out.\")\n            return 1\n\n        await common.dismiss_cookie_banner(page)\n\n        if not _looks_logged_in(page.url):\n            if not headed:\n                print(\"Not logged in and running headless. Re-run with --headed and sign in.\")\n                return 2\n            await assisted_login(page, stamp)\n\n            print()\n            print(\"Now finish the CAPTCHA + 2FA manually in the open browser.\")\n            print(\"Waiting up to 10 minutes for you to land on the dashboard.\")\n            try:\n                await page.wait_for_url(_looks_logged_in, timeout=600_000)\n            except PlaywrightTimeout:\n                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"post_login_stuck\")\n                print(f\"Didn't land on dashboard within 10 min. Final URL: {page.url}\")\n                return 3\n\n        await page.wait_for_load_state(\"networkidle\", timeout=30_000)\n        print(f\"Landed on: {page.url}\")\n        shot, html = await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"landed\")\n        print(f\"Landed dump: {html}\")\n\n        await ctx.close()\n        return 0\n\n\nasync def assisted_login(page, stamp: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Fill what we can — Revolut's bot detection might still reject, but the\n    user only has to do the CAPTCHA + 2FA, not the typing.\"\"\"\n    username, password = get_credentials(PROVIDER)\n    if not username:\n        print(f\"No credentials resolved for '{PROVIDER}' — fill the form manually.\")\n        return\n\n    phone_selectors = [\n        'input[type=\"tel\"]',\n        'input[name=\"phone\"]',\n        'input[name=\"phoneNumber\"]',\n        'input[autocomplete=\"tel\"]',\n    ]\n    if await common.first_visible_fill(page, phone_selectors, username, \"phone\"):\n        # Press Enter or click Continue.\n        try:\n            await page.locator('button[type=\"submit\"], button:has-text(\"Continue\")').first.click(timeout=3000)\n            print(\"  clicked Continue after phone\")\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    if password:\n        # Wait briefly for passcode field; Revolut shows individual digit boxes\n        # for the 6-digit passcode.\n        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)\n        try:\n            digit_inputs = await page.locator('input[type=\"password\"], input[inputmode=\"numeric\"][maxlength=\"1\"]').all()\n            if digit_inputs and len(digit_inputs) == len(password):\n                for inp, ch in zip(digit_inputs, password):\n                    await common.type_into(inp, ch)\n                print(f\"  filled {len(password)}-digit passcode\")\n            elif digit_inputs:\n                # Single passcode field\n                await common.type_into(digit_inputs[0], password)\n                print(\"  filled passcode\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"  passcode fill skipped: {e}\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--headed\", action=\"store_true\", help=\"Show the browser window.\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    return asyncio.run(run(headed=common.auto_headed(PROFILE_DIR, args.headed)))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"
}

Revolut serves the PDF as a normal request\n            # whether it opens in-tab, new tab, or as a download — this\n            # catches all variants.\n            pdf_future: asyncio.Future = asyncio.get_event_loop().create_future()\n\n            def on_response(response):\n                if pdf_future.done():\n                    return\n                ct = (response.headers.get(\"content-type\") or \"\").lower()\n                if \"pdf\" in ct or response.url.lower().endswith(\".pdf\"):\n                    pdf_future.set_result(response)\n\n            page.context.on(\"response\", on_response)\n\n            try:\n                # Click Generate.\n                await page.evaluate(\"\"\"() => {\n                    const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')]\n                        .filter(b => (b.textContent || '').trim() === 'Generate'\n                                  && b.offsetParent !== null);\n                    if (btns.length) btns[btns.length - 1].click();\n                }\"\"\")\n\n                # Wait for any PDF response on the context.\n                response = await asyncio.wait_for(pdf_future, timeout=60)\n                body = await response.body()\n                path = OUTPUT_DIR / f\"{stamp}_revolut_statement.pdf\"\n                path.write_bytes(body)\n                print(f\"  downloaded ({len(body)} bytes): {path}\")\n            finally:\n                page.context.remove_listener(\"response\", on_response)"
}

  "old_string": "def _looks_logged_in(url: str) -> bool:\n    lower = url.lower()\n    if any(x in lower for x in (\"start\", \"signin\", \"sign-in\", \"login\", \"auth\", \"verify\", \"challenge\")):\n        return False\n    return \"app.revolut.com\" in lower",
  "new_string": "def _looks_logged_in(url: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Logged in = host is app.revolut.com AND we're not on a login-y path.\"\"\"\n    p = urlparse(url)\n    if (p.hostname or \"\").lower() != \"app.revolut.com\":\n        return False\n    path = (p.path or \"\").lower()\n    if any(x in path for x in (\"/start\", \"/sign-in\", \"/signin\", \"/login\", \"/passcode\", \"/verify\", \"/challenge\")):\n        return False\n    return True"
}

Returns\n    True if logged in within timeout, False otherwise.\"\"\"\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        if predicate(page.url):\n            return True\n        if DUMP_TRIGGER.exists():\n            try:\n                DUMP_TRIGGER.unlink()\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            try:\n                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, common.now_stamp(), \"manual\")\n                print(f\"  manual dump captured at {page.url}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"  manual dump failed: {e}\")\n        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)\n    return False",
  "new_string": "async def wait_for_login_with_dump_trigger(page, predicate, timeout_s: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Poll for login while:\n      - watching the dump trigger file\n      - auto-filling the passcode the moment a 6-input passcode form appears.\n    Returns True if logged in within timeout, False otherwise.\"\"\"\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s\n    _user, passcode = get_credentials(PROVIDER)\n    passcode_filled = False\n\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        if predicate(page.url):\n            return True\n\n        # Passcode auto-fill — fires whenever the 6-input form appears.\n        if not passcode_filled and passcode and len(passcode) == 6:\n            try:\n                inputs = await page.locator('input[aria-label^=\"Code input\"]').all()\n            except Exception:\n                inputs = []\n            if len(inputs) == 6:\n                try:\n                    await inputs[0].click()\n                    await page.keyboard.type(passcode, delay=80)\n                    await page.keyboard.press(\"Enter\")\n                    print(f\"  auto-filled 6-digit passcode\")\n                    passcode_filled = True\n                except Exception as e:\n                    print(f\"  passcode fill error: {e}\")\n\n        if DUMP_TRIGGER.exists():\n            try:\n                DUMP_TRIGGER.unlink()\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n            try:\n                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, common.now_stamp(), \"manual\")\n                print(f\"  manual dump captured at {page.url}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"  manual dump failed: {e}\")\n        await asyncio.sleep(0.5)\n    return False"
}

same issue!!!!! the script says waiting for download event but the download has alrady happened!

> AGENT

Race condition — `asyncio.create_task` schedules but doesn't guarantee the listener is subscribed before the click fires the download. Switching to `expect_event` context manager, which guarantees the listener is active before the action.

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01CgZKDrj1BgYtx3ubLB5QGJ
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/scrapers/revolut.py",
  "old_string": "            # Listen for downloads on the WHOLE context. Excel opens in a new\n            # tab which triggers Chrome's download dialog — the download event\n            # fires on the context, not on our original page.\n            download_task = asyncio.create_task(\n                page.context.wait_for_event(\"download\", timeout=120_000)\n            )\n            try:\n                # For Excel, Generate IS the download — no intermediate\n                # \"Statement is ready\" step (unlike larger PDF flows).\n                await page.get_by_role(\"button\", name=\"Generate\").click(force=True, timeout=5_000)\n                print(\"  clicked Generate, waiting for download event...\")\n\n                download = await download_task\n                suggested = download.suggested_filename or \"revolut.xlsx\"\n                # Wait for the download stream to actually finish, then copy\n                # the auto-saved file. save_as() has been flaky here for\n                # cross-tab downloads.\n                src = await download.path()\n                if src is None:\n                    raise RuntimeError(\"download.path() returned None\")\n                failure = await download.failure()\n                if failure:\n                    raise RuntimeError(f\"download failed: {failure}\")\n                path = OUTPUT_DIR / f\"{stamp}_{suggested}\"\n                import shutil\n                shutil.copy(str(src), str(path))\n                size = path.stat().st_size\n                print(f\"  downloaded ({size} bytes): {path}\")\n            except Exception:\n                if not download_task.done():\n                    download_task.cancel()\n                raise",
  "new_string": "            # Excel: Generate IS the download. Use expect_event so the listener\n            # is guaranteed active BEFORE the click — otherwise the download\n            # can fire and complete before our listener subscribes.\n            print(\"  clicking Generate and waiting for download event...\")\n            async with page.context.expect_event(\"download\", timeout=120_000) as dl_info:\n                await page.get_by_role(\"button\", name=\"Generate\").click(force=True, timeout=5_000)\n            download = await dl_info.value\n\n            suggested = download.suggested_filename or \"revolut.xlsx\"\n            src = await download.path()\n            if src is None:\n                raise RuntimeError(\"download.path() returned None\")\n            failure = await download.failure()\n            if failure:\n                raise RuntimeError(f\"download failed: {failure}\")\n            path = OUTPUT_DIR / f\"{stamp}_{suggested}\"\n            import shutil\n            shutil.copy(str(src), str(path))\n            size = path.stat().st_size\n            print(f\"  downloaded ({size} bytes): {path}\")"
}

  "new_string": "            # Capture the xlsx bytes directly from the network response —\n            # Playwright's download event is unreliable for new-tab downloads.\n            xlsx_future: asyncio.Future = asyncio.get_event_loop().create_future()\n\n            def on_response(response):\n                if xlsx_future.done():\n                    return\n                url = response.url.lower()\n                ct = (response.headers.get(\"content-type\") or \"\").lower()\n                if (\n                    url.endswith(\".xlsx\")\n                    or \"spreadsheet\" in ct\n                    or \"officedocument\" in ct\n                    or (\"statement\" in url and \"excel\" in ct)\n                ):\n                    xlsx_future.set_result(response)\n\n            page.context.on(\"response\", on_response)\n            try:\n                print(\"  clicking Generate and waiting for xlsx response...\")\n                await page.get_by_role(\"button\", name=\"Generate\").click(force=True, timeout=5_000)\n                response = await asyncio.wait_for(xlsx_future, timeout=120)\n                body = await response.body()\n                # Derive filename from URL or content-disposition.\n                cd = response.headers.get(\"content-disposition\", \"\")\n                suggested = \"revolut.xlsx\"\n                import re as _re\n                m = _re.search(r'filename\\*?=\"?([^\";]+)', cd)\n                if m:\n                    suggested = m.group(1)\n                path = OUTPUT_DIR / f\"{stamp}_{suggested}\"\n                path.write_bytes(body)\n                print(f\"  downloaded ({len(body)} bytes) from {response.url[:80]}: {path}\")\n            finally:\n                page.context.remove_listener(\"response\", on_response)"
}

Look for any of the likely button texts.\n    candidates = [\n        \"Send notification\",\n        \"Send push\",\n        \"Authenticate via app\",\n        \"Verify via app\",\n        \"Use the Revolut app\",\n        \"Verify with app\",\n        \"Approve via app\",\n        \"Confirm in app\",\n    ]\n    clicked = False\n    for label in candidates:\n        try:\n            btn = page.get_by_role(\"button\", name=label).first\n            if await btn.is_visible(timeout=500):\n                await btn.click(force=True)\n                print(f\"  clicked '{label}' — approve on your phone\")\n                clicked = True\n                break\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n\n    if not clicked:\n        # Heuristic: look for \"Access is limited\" / \"limited access\" text.\n        try:\n            for limited_label in (\"Access is limited\", \"Limited access\", \"Verify your identity\"):\n                if await page.get_by_text(limited_label, exact=False).first.is_visible(timeout=500):\n                    print(f\"  detected '{limited_label}' but couldn't find a push-notification button — dumping\")\n                    await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, \"limited_access\")\n                    print(\"  approve manually in the open browser if needed\")\n                    break\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n    if clicked:\n        # }

before)\n                    if not n.endswith(\".crdownload\") and not n.startswith(\".\")\n                ]\n                if new_names:\n                    candidates = [downloads_dir / n for n in new_names]\n                    new_file = max(candidates, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)\n                    print(f\"  caught via filesystem watch: {new_file.name}\")\n                    break\n\n                ticks += 1\n                if ticks % 10 == 0:\n                    print(f\"  ...still waiting ({ticks // 2}s, dl_event_done={download_event_task.done()})\")\n                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)\n\n            if not download_event_task.done():\n                download_event_task.cancel()\n\n            if new_file is None:\n                raise RuntimeError(\"no download detected within 2 min\")"

> AGENT

The download logic now uses network response interception instead of filesystem watching. Run it with:

```
python -m scrapers.revolut --headed
```

The listener watches every response and saves the body the moment it sees one with an Excel content-type (`spreadsheetml` / `officedocument`) or a `.xlsx` URL. No more guessing where Chromium drops the file.

If it still fails, the `download_failed` dump will be in `~/.argus/finance/raw/revolut/` — and the script will print `...waiting for xlsx response (Ns)` every 5 seconds so we can see if the response simply isn't arriving (suggesting Revolut uses a different content-type we should add to the matcher).

1	"""
2	Amex UK scraper.
3	
4	Usage (run from the argus/ directory):
5	    python -m scrapers.amex --headed        # first run, browser opens, do OTP
6	    python -m scrapers.amex                  # subsequent runs, headless
7	    python -m scrapers.amex --format excel   # alternate format
8	
9	Credentials (only consulted when there is no live session):
10	    AMEX_USERNAME + AMEX_PASSWORD env vars, OR
11	    Bitwarden item "amex" (override with AMEX_BW_ITEM).
12	    Unlock Bitwarden once per shell:  export BW_SESSION="$(bw unlock --raw)"
13	
14	Output:
15	    ~/.argus/finance/profiles/amex/   — persistent browser profile
16	    ~/.argus/finance/raw/amex/        — downloaded CSVs and debug dumps
17	"""
18	
19	import argparse
20	import asyncio
21	import sys
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeout
25	
26	from scrapers import _common as common
27	from scrapers.creds import get_credentials
28	
29	PROVIDER = "amex"
30	LOGIN_URL = "https://www.americanexpress.com/en-gb/account/login"
31	ACTIVITY_URL = "https://global.americanexpress.com/activity/recent"
32	
33	PROFILE_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR = common.paths(PROVIDER)
34	
35	FORMAT_RADIO = {
36	    "csv": "#axp-activity-download-body-selection-options-type_csv",
37	    "excel": "#axp-activity-download-body-selection-options-type_excel",
38	    "quickbooks": "#axp-activity-download-body-selection-options-quickbooks",
39	    "quicken": "#axp-activity-download-body-selection-options-quicken",
40	    "qif": "#axp-activity-download-body-selection-options-qif",
41	}
42	
43	USER_FIELDS = ["#eliloUserID", "#user_id", 'input[name="UserID"]', 'input[autocomplete="username"]']
44	PASSWORD_FIELDS = ["#eliloPassword", "#password", 'input[type="password"]', 'input[autocomplete="current-password"]']
45	LOGIN_BUTTON_EXTRA = ["#loginSubmit", '[data-testid*="login" i][role="button"]']
46	
47	
48	def _looks_logged_in(url: str) -> bool:
49	    lower = url.lower()
50	    if any(x in lower for x in ("login", "logon", "identity", "verify", "otp", "challenge")):
51	        return False
52	    return any(x in lower for x in ("activity", "dashboard", "summary", "myca", "account"))
53	
54	
55	async def run(headed: bool, fmt: str) -> int:
56	    stamp = common.now_stamp()
57	
58	    async with async_playwright() as p:
59	        ctx = await p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
60	            user_data_dir=str(PROFILE_DIR),
61	            headless=not headed,
62	            accept_downloads=True,
63	            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 900},
64	        )
65	        for existing in list(ctx.pages):
66	            try:
67	                await existing.close()
68	            except Exception:
69	                pass
70	        page = await ctx.new_page()
71	
72	        try:
73	            await page.goto(ACTIVITY_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30_000)
74	        except PlaywrightTimeout:
75	            print("Initial navigation timed out.")
76	            return 1
77	
78	        await common.dismiss_cookie_banner(page)
79	
80	        if "login" in page.url.lower() or "logon" in page.url.lower():
81	            await interactive_login(page, stamp)
82	            timeout = 600_000 if headed else 30_000
83	            try:
84	                await page.wait_for_url(_looks_logged_in, timeout=timeout)
85	            except PlaywrightTimeout:
86	                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "post_login_stuck")
87	                if not headed:
88	                    print(
89	                        "Headless re-login didn't clear within 30s — likely an OTP prompt. "
90	                        "Re-run with --headed to complete 2FA."
91	                    )
92	                print(f"Final URL: {page.url}")
93	                return 3
94	
95	        if "activity" not in page.url:
96	            await page.goto(ACTIVITY_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
97	        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=30_000)
98	
99	        print(f"Landed on: {page.url}")
100	        await try_download(page, stamp, fmt)
101	
102	        await ctx.close()
103	        return 0
104	
105	
106	async def interactive_login(page, stamp: str) -> None:
107	    username, password = get_credentials(PROVIDER)
108	    if not (username and password):
109	        print("No credentials resolved — fill the form manually in the open browser.")
110	    else:
111	        print("Filling credentials...")
112	        filled_user = await common.first_visible_fill(page, USER_FIELDS, username, "user")
113	        if not filled_user:
114	            try:
115	                await page.get_by_label("User ID", exact=False).first.fill(username, timeout=5000)
116	                filled_user = True
117	                print("  filled user via accessible label")
118	            except Exception:
119	                pass
120	
121	        filled_pw = await common.first_visible_fill(page, PASSWORD_FIELDS, password, "password")
122	
123	        if not (filled_user and filled_pw):
124	            await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "fill_failed")
125	            print("  could not fill form — see screenshot")
126	        else:
127	            await common.tick_remember_me(page)
128	            if not await common.click_login_button(page, LOGIN_BUTTON_EXTRA):
129	                await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "no_login_button")
130	                print("  could not find login button — click it manually in the open browser.")
131	
132	    print()
133	    print("If Amex prompts for OTP / 'verify it's you', complete it in the open browser.")
134	    print("Waiting up to 10 minutes for the dashboard to load.")
135	
136	
137	async def try_download(page, stamp: str, fmt: str) -> Path | None:
138	    print(f"Clicking Download (format={fmt})...")
139	    try:
140	        await page.locator('#action-icon-dls-icon-download-').first.click(timeout=10_000)
141	    except PlaywrightTimeout:
142	        try:
143	            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Download").first.click(timeout=5_000)
144	        except PlaywrightTimeout:
145	            await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "no_download_button")
146	            print("  could not click Download button — see screenshot")
147	            return None
148	
149	    radio_sel = FORMAT_RADIO.get(fmt)
150	    if not radio_sel:
151	        print(f"  unknown format: {fmt}")
152	        return None
153	    try:
154	        radio = page.locator(radio_sel)
155	        await radio.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10_000)
156	        await radio.check(timeout=5_000)
157	        print(f"  selected format radio: {fmt}")
158	    except PlaywrightTimeout:
159	        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "radio_missing")
160	        print(f"  {fmt} radio not found — see screenshot")
161	        return None
162	
163	    # Amex clears the "include all details" checkbox when the format radio
164	    # changes, so set it AFTER picking the format and verify it stuck.
165	    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
166	    try:
167	        details_cb = page.locator('#axp-activity-download-body-checkbox-options-includeAll')
168	        await details_cb.wait_for(state="attached", timeout=5_000)
169	        if not await details_cb.is_checked():
170	            await details_cb.check(timeout=3_000, force=True)
171	        if await details_cb.is_checked():
172	            print("  ticked 'include all details'")
173	        else:
174	            print("  WARN: 'include all details' did not stick after force-check")
175	    except Exception as e:
176	        print(f"  could not tick include-all: {e}")
177	
178	    try:
179	        async with page.expect_download(timeout=30_000) as dl_info:
180	            await page.locator('[data-test-id="axp-activity-download-footer-download-confirm"]').click(timeout=5_000)
181	        download = await dl_info.value
182	        suggested = download.suggested_filename or "amex.csv"
183	        path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"{stamp}_{suggested}"
184	        await download.save_as(str(path))
185	        print(f"  downloaded: {path}")
186	        return path
187	    except PlaywrightTimeout:
188	        await common.dump_state(page, OUTPUT_DIR, stamp, "confirm_failed")
189	        print("  Confirm click failed or no download arrived — see screenshot")
190	        return None
191	
192	
193	def main() -> int:
194	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
195	    parser.add_argument("--headed", action="store_true", help="Show the browser window.")
196	    parser.add_argument("--format", choices=sorted(FORMAT_RADIO), default="csv")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	    return asyncio.run(run(headed=common.auto_headed(PROFILE_DIR, args.headed), fmt=args.format))
199	
200	
201	if __name__ == "__main__":
202	    sys.exit(main())

1	"""
2	Credential resolution for scrapers.
3	
4	Order of resolution for a provider like "amex":
5	  1. Direct env vars: AMEX_USERNAME and AMEX_PASSWORD
6	  2. Bitwarden CLI: looks up item named "amex" (override with AMEX_BW_ITEM).
7	     Requires BW_SESSION to be set. To get one:
8	         export BW_SESSION="$(bw unlock --raw)"
9	
10	Supported Bitwarden item types:
11	  - Login (type 1): returns (login.username, login.password)
12	  - Card  (type 3): returns (card.number, custom_field "passcode")
13	                    The passcode field on a Card item is the CVV (3-4 digits),
14	                    not the online banking passcode — so the latter must live
15	                    in a custom field. Add one named exactly "passcode".
16	
17	Returns (username, password) or (None, None) if nothing resolved.
18	"""
19	
20	import json
21	import os
22	import subprocess
23	
24	BW_TYPE_LOGIN = 1
25	BW_TYPE_CARD = 3
26	
27	
28	def get_credentials(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
29	    upper = provider.upper()
30	
31	    u = os.environ.get(f"{upper}_USERNAME")
32	    p = os.environ.get(f"{upper}_PASSWORD")
33	    if u and p:
34	        return u, p
35	
36	    item_name = os.environ.get(f"{upper}_BW_ITEM", provider)
37	    return _from_bitwarden(item_name)
38	
39	
40	def get_card(provider: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
41	    """Return (card_number, cvv) for a provider's Card item in Bitwarden."""
42	    session = os.environ.get("BW_SESSION")
43	    if not session:
44	        return None, None
45	    item_name = os.environ.get(f"{provider.upper()}_BW_CARD_ITEM", provider)
46	    items = _bw_run(["bw", "list", "items", "--search", item_name, "--session", session])
47	    if not isinstance(items, list):
48	        return None, None
49	    cards = [i for i in items if i.get("type") == BW_TYPE_CARD]
50	    if not cards:
51	        return None, None
52	    exact = [i for i in cards if (i.get("name") or "").strip() == item_name]
53	    card = (exact or cards)[0].get("card") or {}
54	    return card.get("number"), card.get("code")
55	
56	
57	def _from_bitwarden(item_name: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
58	    """Try direct lookup; if ambiguous, fall back to search + filter by type.
59	    Prefers Login items over Card items."""
60	    session = os.environ.get("BW_SESSION")
61	    if not session:
62	        return None, None
63	
64	    direct = _bw_run(["bw", "get", "item", item_name, "--session", session])
65	    if isinstance(direct, dict):
66	        return _extract(direct)
67	
68	    items = _bw_run(["bw", "list", "items", "--search", item_name, "--session", session])
69	    if not isinstance(items, list) or not items:
70	        return None, None
71	
72	    # Prefer Login type over Card type — within each, prefer exact name match.
73	    for wanted in (BW_TYPE_LOGIN, BW_TYPE_CARD):
74	        by_type = [i for i in items if i.get("type") == wanted]
75	        if not by_type:
76	            continue
77	        exact = [i for i in by_type if (i.get("name") or "").strip() == item_name]
78	        return _extract((exact or by_type)[0])
79	
80	    return None, None
81	
82	
83	def _extract(item: dict) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
84	    t = item.get("type")
85	    if t == BW_TYPE_LOGIN:
86	        login = (item.get("login") or {})
87	        return login.get("username"), login.get("password")
88	    if t == BW_TYPE_CARD:
89	        card = (item.get("card") or {})
90	        return card.get("number"), _custom_field(item, "passcode")
91	    return None, None
92	
93	
94	def _bw_run(cmd: list[str]) -> dict | list | None:
95	    try:
96	        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
97	    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
98	        return None
99	    if result.returncode != 0:
100	        return None
101	    try:
102	        return json.loads(result.stdout)
103	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
104	        return None
105	
106	
107	def _norm(s: str | None) -> str:
108	    return "".join(c.lower() for c in (s or "") if c.isalnum())
109	
110	
111	def _custom_field(item: dict, name: str) -> str | None:
112	    target = _norm(name)
113	    for field in (item.get("fields") or []):
114	        if _norm(field.get("name")) == target:
115	            return field.get("value")
116	    return None
117	
118	
119	def get_custom_field(provider: str, field_name: str) -> str | None:
120	    """Look up a Bitwarden custom field on any item matching the provider name.
121	    Field-name match is fuzzy: ignores case, spaces, underscores, hyphens."""
122	    session = os.environ.get("BW_SESSION")
123	    if not session:
124	        return None
125	    item_name = os.environ.get(f"{provider.upper()}_BW_ITEM", provider)
126	    items = _bw_run(["bw", "list", "items", "--search", item_name, "--session", session])
127	    if not isinstance(items, list):
128	        return None
129	    # Prefer Login item, then Card.
130	    for wanted in (BW_TYPE_LOGIN, BW_TYPE_CARD):
131	        for item in items:
132	            if item.get("type") != wanted:
133	                continue
134	            val = _custom_field(item, field_name)
135	            if val:
136	                return val
137	    return None
138

> AGENT

**Diagnosis confirmed.** Your `bw` (Homebrew 2026.4.1) is **ignoring `--session`** and demanding interactive password entry on every call. That's a regression — must've come in via a Homebrew update in the last 2 days. The Node error is just bw crashing when stdin's closed before it can prompt.

Without `--session` working, no Python subprocess will ever get cred data out of `bw` — which is why every scraper now fails the same way.

Two ways to fix:

**Option A — downgrade `bw`** (cleanest, restores everything):
```
brew uninstall bitwarden-cli
brew install bitwarden-cli@2024
# OR pin to a specific older formula
```
(There's likely a working version 1.22.x or similar.)

**Option B — JSON cache file** (works around the bug, no `bw` install changes):
You dump each item once interactively into `~/.argus/bw_cache/<provider>.json`, the scrapers read from disk. Fast, deterministic, no `bw` calls from Python.

Which do you want — try downgrade first, or just do the cache file?
