```json
{
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/finance/parsers/nationwide.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Nationwide UK CSV parser.\n\nFile format (with BOM):\n    \"Account Name:\",\"FlexDirect Account ****44568\"\n    \"Account Balance:\",\"£1.00\"\n    \"Available Balance: \",\"£1.00\"\n    <blank line>\n    \"Date\",\"Transaction type\",\"Description\",\"Paid out\",\"Paid in\",\"Balance\"\n    \"04 May 2026\",\"Bank credit\",\"Trading 212 UK Limited\",\"\",\"£477.00\",\"£477.48\"\n\nAccount label comes from the preamble. Date format is \"DD MMM YYYY\".\nPaid out / Paid in are mutually exclusive — we collapse them into a\nsingle signed `amount` (+ = paid in, - = paid out).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nPROVIDER = \"nationwide\"\nACCOUNT_TYPE = \"debit\"\n\n_MONEY_RE = re.compile(r\"-?[\\d,]+\\.\\d{2}\")\n\n\ndef parse(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Iterator[dict]]:\n    account_label, header_idx, lines = _read_with_preamble(path)\n    return account_label, _iter(lines[header_idx + 1:], lines[header_idx])\n\n\ndef _read_with_preamble(path: Path) -> tuple[str, int, list[list[str]]]:\n    \"\"\"Parse the preamble (account label + balance) and return:\n      (account_label, header_row_index, all_rows_as_lists).\"\"\"\n    with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8-sig\") as f:\n        rows = list(csv.reader(f))\n\n    account_label = \"default\"\n    header_idx = 0\n    for i, row in enumerate(rows):\n        if not row:\n            continue\n        first = (row[0] or \"\").strip().strip(\":\").lower()\n        if first == \"account name\" and len(row) > 1:\n            account_label = (row[1] or \"\").strip() or \"default\"\n        if first.lower() == \"date\":\n            header_idx = i\n            break\n\n    return account_label, header_idx, rows\n\n\ndef _iter(data_rows, header_row) -> Iterator[dict]:\n    headers = [h.strip() for h in header_row]\n    for row in data_rows:\n        if not row or not any(c.strip() for c in row):\n            continue\n        rec = dict(zip(headers, [c.strip() for c in row]))\n        date_raw = rec.get(\"Date\", \"\")\n        try:\n            date = datetime.strptime(date_raw, \"%d %b %Y\").strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n\n        paid_in = _money(rec.get(\"Paid in\", \"\"))\n        paid_out = _money(rec.get(\"Paid out\", \"\"))\n        if paid_in is not None:\n            amount = paid_in\n        elif paid_out is not None:\n            amount = -paid_out\n        else:\n            continue\n\n        balance_after = _money(rec.get(\"Balance\", \"\"))\n        description = (rec.get(\"Description\") or \"\").strip()\n        ttype = (rec.get(\"Transaction type\") or \"\").strip() or None\n\n        yield {\n            \"date\": date,\n            \"amount\": amount,\n            \"balance_after\": balance_after,\n            \"description\": description,\n            \"transaction_type\": ttype,\n            \"raw\": rec,\n        }\n\n\ndef _money(s: str) -> float | None:\n    if not s:\n        return None\n    m = _MONEY_RE.search(s)\n    if not m:\n        return None\n    return float(m.group(0).replace(\",\", \"\"))\n"
}
```

```json
{

  "content": "\"\"\"Revolut CSV parser.\n\nHeader:\n    Type,Product,Started Date,Completed Date,Description,Amount,Fee,\n    Currency,State,Balance\n\nDates are full ISO timestamps; we keep just the date (sub-day precision\nlives in raw). Amount is already signed correctly. Only COMPLETED rows\nare ingested. If Currency != account currency (GBP) we capture it as\noriginal_currency/original_amount.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nPROVIDER = \"revolut\"\nACCOUNT_TYPE = \"debit\"\n\n\ndef parse(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Iterator[dict]]:\n    return \"default\", _iter(path)\n\n\ndef _iter(path: Path) -> Iterator[dict]:\n    with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8-sig\") as f:\n        reader = csv.DictReader(f)\n        for row in reader:\n            state = (row.get(\"State\") or \"\").strip().upper()\n            if state and state != \"COMPLETED\":\n                continue\n            started = _date_only(row.get(\"Started Date\", \"\"))\n            completed = _date_only(row.get(\"Completed Date\", \"\")) or started\n            if not completed:\n                continue\n            try:\n                amount = float((row.get(\"Amount\") or \"0\").replace(\",\", \"\"))\n            except ValueError:\n                continue\n            try:\n                fee = float((row.get(\"Fee\") or \"0\").replace(\",\", \"\") or 0)\n            except ValueError:\n                fee = 0.0\n            try:\n                balance = float((row.get(\"Balance\") or \"\").replace(\",\", \"\"))\n            except ValueError:\n                balance = None\n\n            currency = (row.get(\"Currency\") or \"GBP\").strip().upper()\n            description = (row.get(\"Description\") or \"\").strip()\n            ttype = (row.get(\"Type\") or \"\").strip() or None\n            counterparty = description if ttype == \"Transfer\" else None\n\n            tx = {\n                \"date\": completed,\n                \"amount\": amount,\n                \"fee\": fee,\n                \"balance_after\": balance,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"transaction_type\": ttype,\n                \"counterparty\": counterparty,\n                \"raw\": dict(row),\n            }\n            if started and started != completed:\n                tx[\"initiated_date\"] = started\n            if currency and currency != \"GBP\":\n                tx[\"original_amount\"] = amount\n                tx[\"original_currency\"] = currency\n            yield tx\n\n\ndef _date_only(s: str) -> str | None:\n    s = (s or \"\").strip()\n    if not s:\n        return None\n    for fmt in (\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\", \"%Y-%m-%d\"):\n        try:\n            return datetime.strptime(s, fmt).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n    return None\n"
}
```

```json
{
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/finance/parsers/santander.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Santander midata CSV parser.\n\nSemicolon-delimited. Header:\n    Date;Type;Merchant/Description;Debit/Credit;Balance;\n\nDate: DD/MM/YYYY.\nDebit/Credit and Balance both have a currency symbol prefix that may be\nmangled by encoding (\"£\" → \"�\"). We pull out the signed numeric part.\nDescriptions are deliberately redacted by Santander (asterisks) — that's\nthe midata format, not a bug.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nPROVIDER = \"santander\"\nACCOUNT_TYPE = \"debit\"\n\n_SIGNED_NUM = re.compile(r\"[+-]?[\\d,]+\\.\\d{2}\")\n\n\ndef parse(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Iterator[dict]]:\n    return \"default\", _iter(path)\n\n\ndef _iter(path: Path) -> Iterator[dict]:\n    with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8-sig\", errors=\"replace\") as f:\n        reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter=\";\")\n        for row in reader:\n            if len(row) < 5:\n                continue\n            if not row[0] or row[0].strip().lower() == \"date\":\n                continue\n            try:\n                date = datetime.strptime(row[0].strip(), \"%d/%m/%Y\").strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n            except ValueError:\n                continue\n            ttype = (row[1] or \"\").strip() or None\n            description = (row[2] or \"\").strip()\n            amount = _signed_amount(row[3])\n            balance = _signed_amount(row[4])\n            if amount is None:\n                continue\n\n            yield {\n                \"date\": date,\n                \"amount\": amount,\n                \"balance_after\": balance,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"transaction_type\": ttype,\n                \"raw\": {\n                    \"date\": row[0], \"type\": row[1], \"description\": row[2],\n                    \"debit_credit\": row[3], \"balance\": row[4],\n                },\n            }\n\n\ndef _signed_amount(s: str) -> float | None:\n    if not s:\n        return None\n    m = _SIGNED_NUM.search(s)\n    if not m:\n        return None\n    return float(m.group(0).replace(\",\", \"\"))\n"
}
```

```json
  "content": "\"\"\"Ingest scraped CSVs into the unified finance DB.\n\nWalks ~/.argus/finance/raw/<provider>/ for any CSV not already recorded\nin the `imports` table, dispatches to the right parser, writes rows\nthrough `insert_transaction` (which dedups on dedup_hash). Also picks up\nthe `<ts>_balance.json` sidecars the credit-card scrapers write and\ninserts them into `balance_snapshots`.\n\nUsage:\n    python -m finance.ingest                  # ingest everything new\n    python -m finance.ingest --provider amex  # just one provider\n    python -m finance.ingest --redo           # re-ingest already-imported files\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom src.finance_db import (\n    dedup_hash,\n    get_db,\n    init_db,\n    insert_transaction,\n    upsert_account,\n)\nfrom finance.parsers import BY_NAME\n\nRAW_DIR = Path.home() / \".argus\" / \"finance\" / \"raw\"\n\n\ndef already_imported(conn, source_file: str) -> bool:\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM imports WHERE source_file = ? AND status = 'success' LIMIT 1\",\n        (source_file,),\n    ).fetchone()\n    return row is not None\n\n\ndef record_import(conn, provider, source_file, rows_read, added, skipped, status, error=None):\n    conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO imports (provider, source_file, rows_read, transactions_added,\"\n        \" transactions_skipped, status, error) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (provider, source_file, rows_read, added, skipped, status, error),\n    )\n\n\ndef ingest_csv(conn, parser, csv_path: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:\n    \"\"\"Parse one CSV → insert rows → return (added, skipped).\"\"\"\n    account_label, tx_iter = parser.parse(csv_path)\n    account_id = upsert_account(\n        conn,\n        provider=parser.PROVIDER,\n        label=account_label,\n        account_type=parser.ACCOUNT_TYPE,\n    )\n\n    added = skipped = rows = 0\n    for tx in tx_iter:\n        rows += 1\n        amount = tx[\"amount\"]\n        description = tx[\"description\"]\n        date = tx[\"date\"]\n        h = dedup_hash(\n            provider=parser.PROVIDER,\n            account_label=account_label,\n            date=date,\n            amount=amount,\n            description=description,\n            reference=tx.get(\"reference\"),\n        )\n        row = {\n            \"account_id\": account_id,\n            \"source_file\": str(csv_path),\n            \"dedup_hash\": h,\n            \"date\": date,\n            \"initiated_date\": tx.get(\"initiated_date\"),\n            \"amount\": amount,\n            \"fee\": tx.get(\"fee\") or 0,\n            \"balance_after\": tx.get(\"balance_after\"),\n            \"original_amount\": tx.get(\"original_amount\"),\n            \"original_currency\": tx.get(\"original_currency\"),\n            \"description\": description,\n            \"merchant\": tx.get(\"merchant\"),\n            \"counterparty\": tx.get(\"counterparty\"),\n            \"transaction_type\": tx.get(\"transaction_type\"),\n            \"reference\": tx.get(\"reference\"),\n            \"provider_category\": tx.get(\"provider_category\"),\n            \"raw_json\": json.dumps(tx.get(\"raw\", {}), default=str),\n        }\n        _id, was_new = insert_transaction(conn, row)\n        if was_new:\n            added += 1\n        else:\n            skipped += 1\n\n    return rows, added, skipped\n\n\ndef ingest_balance_sidecar(conn, provider: str, json_path: Path) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Insert a single balance_snapshots row from a scraper JSON sidecar.\n    Returns True if a new row was inserted (False if dup or malformed).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(json_path.read_text())\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  ! {json_path.name}: bad JSON ({e})\")\n        return False\n\n    balance = data.get(\"balance\")\n    if balance is None:\n        return False\n\n    account_label = data.get(\"account_label\") or \"default\"\n    # Account-type guess only for first-time upsert; real type came from seed.\n    account_type = \"credit_card\" if provider in (\"amex\", \"barclaycard\") else \"debit\"\n    account_id = upsert_account(conn, provider=provider, label=account_label, account_type=account_type)\n\n    scraped_at = data.get(\"scraped_at\") or \"\"\n    snap_date = scraped_at[:10] if scraped_at else datetime.now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO balance_snapshots (account_id, date, balance, source, raw)\"\n        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'scraper', ?)\",\n        (account_id, snap_date, float(balance), data.get(\"raw\")),\n    )\n    return cur.rowcount > 0\n\n\ndef ingest_provider(conn, provider: str, redo: bool = False) -> dict:\n    parser = BY_NAME.get(provider)\n    if parser is None:\n        return {\"provider\": provider, \"error\": \"no parser\"}\n\n    provider_dir = RAW_DIR / provider\n    if not provider_dir.exists():\n        return {\"provider\": provider, \"files\": 0}\n\n    csvs = sorted(provider_dir.glob(\"*.csv\"))\n    balance_jsons = sorted(provider_dir.glob(\"*_balance.json\"))\n\n    files_processed = 0\n    total_added = total_skipped = 0\n    for csv_path in csvs:\n        if not redo and already_imported(conn, str(csv_path)):\n            continue\n        try:\n            rows, added, skipped = ingest_csv(conn, parser, csv_path)\n            record_import(conn, provider, str(csv_path), rows, added, skipped, \"success\")\n            print(f\"  ✓ {csv_path.name}: {added} added, {skipped} skipped ({rows} rows)\")\n            total_added += added\n            total_skipped += skipped\n            files_processed += 1\n        except Exception as e:\n            record_import(conn, provider, str(csv_path), 0, 0, 0, \"error\", str(e))\n            print(f\"  ✗ {csv_path.name}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}\")\n\n    new_balances = 0\n    for json_path in balance_jsons:\n        if ingest_balance_sidecar(conn, provider, json_path):\n            new_balances += 1\n    if new_balances:\n        print(f\"  + {new_balances} new balance snapshot(s)\")\n\n    conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"provider\": provider,\n        \"files\": files_processed,\n        \"added\": total_added,\n        \"skipped\": total_skipped,\n        \"balances\": new_balances,\n    }\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--provider\", help=\"Only ingest this provider's files\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--redo\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"Re-ingest CSVs that are already in the imports table\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    init_db()\n    conn = get_db()\n\n    providers = [args.provider] if args.provider else sorted(BY_NAME)\n    summaries = []\n    for p in providers:\n        print(f\"\\n=== {p} ===\")\n        summaries.append(ingest_provider(conn, p, redo=args.redo))\n\n    conn.close()\n\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*40}\\n  SUMMARY\\n{'='*40}\")\n    for s in summaries:\n        if \"error\" in s:\n            print(f\"  {s['provider']:<13} ERROR: {s['error']}\")\n            continue\n        print(\n            f\"  {s['provider']:<13} files={s.get('files', 0):>2}\"\n            f\"  +{s.get('added', 0):>4} tx  ({s.get('skipped', 0)} dup)\"\n            f\"  +{s.get('balances', 0)} balance\"\n        )\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"
}
```

> AGENT

Found it — `fee NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` and `is_transfer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`. When the helper passes `None` explicitly, the DEFAULT doesn't apply, NOT NULL fails, `INSERT OR IGNORE` swallows the error. Need to omit `None` columns from the SQL so DEFAULTs kick in:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01MALGWTZb75oHKqmchtjy98
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/src/finance_db.py",
  "old_string": "    cols = [\n        \"account_id\", \"source_file\", \"dedup_hash\",\n        \"date\", \"initiated_date\",\n        \"amount\", \"fee\", \"balance_after\",\n        \"original_amount\", \"original_currency\",\n        \"description\", \"merchant\", \"counterparty\",\n        \"transaction_type\", \"reference\", \"provider_category\",\n        \"category_id\", \"tags\", \"notes\",\n        \"is_transfer\", \"paired_id\",\n        \"raw_json\",\n    ]\n    placeholders = \", \".join(\"?\" for _ in cols)\n    sql = (\n        f\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO transactions ({', '.join(cols)})\"\n        f\" VALUES ({placeholders})\"\n    )\n    values = [tx.get(c) for c in cols]\n    # Required cols can't be None.\n    for required in (\"account_id\", \"source_file\", \"dedup_hash\", \"date\", \"amount\", \"description\", \"raw_json\"):\n        if tx.get(required) is None:\n            raise ValueError(f\"insert_transaction: missing required field {required!r}\")\n\n    cur = conn.execute(sql, values)",
  "new_string": "    allowed_cols = (\n        \"account_id\", \"source_file\", \"dedup_hash\",\n        \"date\", \"initiated_date\",\n        \"amount\", \"fee\", \"balance_after\",\n        \"original_amount\", \"original_currency\",\n        \"description\", \"merchant\", \"counterparty\",\n        \"transaction_type\", \"reference\", \"provider_category\",\n        \"category_id\", \"tags\", \"notes\",\n        \"is_transfer\", \"paired_id\",\n        \"raw_json\",\n    )\n    # Required cols can't be None.\n    for required in (\"account_id\", \"source_file\", \"dedup_hash\", \"date\", \"amount\", \"description\", \"raw_json\"):\n        if tx.get(required) is None:\n            raise ValueError(f\"insert_transaction: missing required field {required!r}\")\n\n    # Only include columns whose value is not None — lets the schema DEFAULTs\n    # apply (otherwise passing NULL explicitly violates NOT NULL constraints\n    # on fee / is_transfer despite their DEFAULTs).\n    cols = [c for c in allowed_cols if tx.get(c) is not None]\n    values = [tx[c] for c in cols]\n    placeholders = \", \".join(\"?\" for _ in cols)\n    sql = (\n        f\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO transactions ({', '.join(cols)})\"\n        f\" VALUES ({placeholders})\"\n    )\n    cur = conn.execute(sql, values)"
}
```

```json
  "new_string": "def _signed_amount(s: str) -> float | None:\n    \"\"\"Parse Santander's `-£212.29` / `+£69.47` (or with the currency symbol\n    mangled to `�`). The non-digit currency symbol sits between the sign\n    and the number, so we strip it before regex matching.\"\"\"\n    if not s:\n        return None\n    cleaned = \"\".join(c for c in s if c.isdigit() or c in \"+-.,\")\n    m = _SIGNED_NUM.search(cleaned)\n    if not m:\n        return None\n    return float(m.group(0).replace(\",\", \"\"))"
}
```

```json
{
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/finance/pair_transfers.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Pair internal transfers across accounts.\n\nA transfer is one money movement that shows up as two transactions on\ndifferent accounts: a `-X` on the source and a `+X` on the destination\nwithin a small time window. Examples in this user's data:\n\n  Nationwide  -£1440.50  AMERICAN EXPRESS      (May 15)\n  Amex        +£1440.50  PAYMENT RECEIVED      (May 15-ish)\n\n  Nationwide  -£359.17   B/CARD FORWARD        (May 08)\n  Barclaycard +£359.17   Payment By Direct Debit (May 08)\n\n  Nationwide  +£477.00   Trading 212 UK        (May 04)   ← Trading 212 not scraped, won't pair\n\nWe mark both legs `is_transfer = 1` and set `paired_id` on each so\nspending reports can exclude them. Also tag both with the 'Transfer'\ncategory so they appear sensibly in category views.\n\nMatching rule:\n  - opposite-signed amounts of equal magnitude (rounded to 2dp)\n  - different accounts\n  - dates within ±N days (default 3)\n  - both legs currently unpaired\n\nIf a transaction has multiple equally-good candidates, we skip it\n(ambiguous — would need description-text-matching to disambiguate).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport sys\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta\n\nfrom src.finance_db import get_db\n\n\ndef _date_diff(a: str, b: str) -> int:\n    da = datetime.strptime(a, \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    db = datetime.strptime(b, \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n    return abs((da - db).days)\n\n\ndef pair_transfers(conn, window_days: int = 3) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Pair unmatched transfers. Returns counters dict.\"\"\"\n    # Look up Transfer category id (seeded by init_db).\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Transfer'\").fetchone()\n    transfer_cat_id = row[\"id\"] if row else None\n\n    # Fetch all currently-unpaired transactions.\n    rows = conn.execute(\"\"\"\n        SELECT id, account_id, date, amount, description\n          FROM transactions\n         WHERE is_transfer = 0 AND paired_id IS NULL\n         ORDER BY date, id\n    \"\"\").fetchall()\n\n    # Index positives by magnitude for fast lookup. We'll iterate negatives\n    # once and look for matching positives — never iterate both directions\n    # so each pair is considered exactly once.\n    positives_by_mag: dict[float, list] = defaultdict(list)\n    for r in rows:\n        if r[\"amount\"] > 0:\n            positives_by_mag[round(r[\"amount\"], 2)].append(r)\n\n    already_used: set[int] = set()\n    pairs = []\n    ambiguous = 0\n\n    for neg in rows:\n        if neg[\"amount\"] >= 0:\n            continue\n        if neg[\"id\"] in already_used:\n            continue\n        mag = round(-neg[\"amount\"], 2)\n        candidates = [\n            p for p in positives_by_mag.get(mag, [])\n            if p[\"id\"] not in already_used\n            and p[\"account_id\"] != neg[\"account_id\"]\n            and _date_diff(p[\"date\"], neg[\"date\"]) <= window_days\n        ]\n        if not candidates:\n            continue\n        if len(candidates) > 1:\n            ambiguous += 1\n            continue\n        match = candidates[0]\n        pairs.append((neg[\"id\"], match[\"id\"]))\n        already_used.add(neg[\"id\"])\n        already_used.add(match[\"id\"])\n\n    # Apply.\n    for a_id, b_id in pairs:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE transactions SET is_transfer = 1, paired_id = ?,\"\n            \" category_id = COALESCE(category_id, ?)\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\",\n            (b_id, transfer_cat_id, a_id),\n        )\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE transactions SET is_transfer = 1, paired_id = ?,\"\n            \" category_id = COALESCE(category_id, ?)\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\",\n            (a_id, transfer_cat_id, b_id),\n        )\n\n    conn.commit()\n    return {\n        \"pairs_made\": len(pairs),\n        \"ambiguous_skipped\": ambiguous,\n        \"unpaired_negatives\": sum(\n            1 for r in rows\n            if r[\"amount\"] < 0 and r[\"id\"] not in already_used\n        ),\n    }\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--window\", type=int, default=3,\n                        help=\"Date-match window in days (default: 3)\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--dry-run\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"Print pairs that would be made, but don't write\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--show\", action=\"store_true\",\n                        help=\"After pairing, print the new pairs for inspection\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    conn = get_db()\n\n    if args.dry_run:\n        # Replay the matching logic without UPDATEs by wrapping in a transaction\n        # we never commit, then rolling back.\n        conn.execute(\"BEGIN\")\n        try:\n            stats = pair_transfers(conn, window_days=args.window)\n            print(\"DRY-RUN — no changes committed.\")\n            print(stats)\n        finally:\n            conn.rollback()\n        conn.close()\n        return 0\n\n    stats = pair_transfers(conn, window_days=args.window)\n    print(f\"Pairs made:           {stats['pairs_made']}\")\n    print(f\"Ambiguous (skipped):  {stats['ambiguous_skipped']}\")\n    print(f\"Unpaired negatives:   {stats['unpaired_negatives']}\")\n\n    if args.show and stats[\"pairs_made\"]:\n        print(\"\\nPaired transactions:\")\n        for row in conn.execute(\"\"\"\n            SELECT t.id, a.provider, t.date, t.amount, t.description, t.paired_id\n              FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id\n             WHERE t.is_transfer = 1\n             ORDER BY ABS(t.amount) DESC, t.paired_id, t.amount\n        \"\"\"):\n            print(f\"  [{row['id']:>4}] {row['provider']:<11} {row['date']} {row['amount']:>10.2f}  ↔ #{row['paired_id']:<4}  {row['description'][:50]}\")\n\n    conn.close()\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"
}
```

> AGENT

Confirmed — the latest Santander download (run today) has its newest transaction dated **15 Apr 2026**. Santander's midata appears to be lagging by a month (it's fed from statement-cycle data, not real-time).

So your £1440 from Santander on May 15:
- Showed up correctly on Nationwide as a credit
- Doesn't exist yet in our Santander rows → no pair to make
- Will appear once Santander's midata catches up to May, and re-ingest will then pair it

**This is a data freshness issue, not a pairing bug.** The pairing logic itself is correct — when both legs are present, it finds them.

A couple of ways to improve this:
1. **Wait for Santander to catch up** — once your May statement closes, midata will include May data on next scrape.
2. **Use the Excel/XLS download instead** — Santander's other formats might be more current. Worth checking next month if midata still lags.
3. **Accept the lag** — for budget purposes, transfers eventually pair when both legs appear. The current month's spending picture is slightly inflated until then.

Want me to save this as a known limitation, or investigate the Santander download formats now?

```json
{
  "file_path": "/Users/sumeet/matrix/web/argus/argus/finance/parsers/santander.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"Santander Excel (\"XLS\") parser.\n\nSantander's \"Microsoft Excel (XLS)\" export is actually an HTML table\nfile with an .xls extension (Excel opens it as a table). Real merchant\ndescriptions, recent transactions (no statement-cycle lag like midata).\n\nFile structure:\n    row 0:  Transactions          (title)\n    row 1:  XXXX XXXX XXXX 0355   (account label)  |  DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY\n    row 3:  Date | Description | Money in | Money Out | Balance\n    row 5+: actual transactions\n\nOlder `.csv` midata files (descriptions redacted with ****) are still\nrecognised by the dispatcher for backwards compatibility — those rows\nremain in the DB but new pulls use the Excel format.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport re\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nPROVIDER = \"santander\"\nACCOUNT_TYPE = \"debit\"\n\n_MONEY_RE = re.compile(r\"-?[\\d,]+\\.\\d{2}\")\n_TAG_RE = re.compile(r\"<[^>]+>\")\n_TR_RE = re.compile(r\"<tr[^>]*>(.*?)</tr>\", re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n_CELL_RE = re.compile(r\"<t[dh][^>]*>(.*?)</t[dh]>\", re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)\n\n\ndef parse(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Iterator[dict]]:\n    if path.suffix.lower() == \".xls\" or _looks_html(path):\n        return _parse_xls_html(path)\n    return _parse_midata_csv(path)\n\n\ndef _looks_html(path: Path) -> bool:\n    try:\n        with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n            return f.read(256).lstrip().lower().startswith(b\"<!doctype html\")\n    except Exception:\n        return False\n\n\n# ---------- Excel (HTML-table-with-.xls) ---------------------------------\n\n\ndef _parse_xls_html(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Iterator[dict]]:\n    html = path.read_text(encoding=\"iso-8859-1\")\n    rows = [_cells(r) for r in _TR_RE.findall(html)]\n\n    # Find the account label (first row that has the masked account format).\n    account_label = \"default\"\n    for row in rows[:5]:\n        for cell in row:\n            if re.match(r\"X{4}\\s*X{4}\\s*X{4}\\s*\\d{4}\", cell):\n                account_label = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", cell.rstrip(\":\")).strip()\n                break\n        if account_label != \"default\":\n            break\n\n    # Find the header row (Date | Description | Money in | Money Out | Balance)\n    header_idx = None\n    for i, row in enumerate(rows):\n        normalised = [c.lower() for c in row]\n        if \"date\" in normalised and \"description\" in normalised:\n            header_idx = i\n            break\n\n    return account_label, _iter_xls(rows, header_idx)\n\n\ndef _iter_xls(rows, header_idx) -> Iterator[dict]:\n    if header_idx is None:\n        return\n    for raw in rows[header_idx + 1:]:\n        if not raw or all(not c for c in raw):\n            continue\n        if len(raw) < 5:\n            continue\n        date_raw, description, money_in, money_out, balance = raw[:5]\n        try:\n            date = datetime.strptime(date_raw.strip(), \"%d/%m/%Y\").strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n        in_val = _money(money_in)\n        out_val = _money(money_out)\n        if in_val is not None:\n            amount = in_val\n        elif out_val is not None:\n            amount = -out_val\n        else:\n            continue\n        balance_after = _money(balance)\n        description = \" \".join(description.split())  # collapse whitespace\n        yield {\n            \"date\": date,\n            \"amount\": amount,\n            \"balance_after\": balance_after,\n            \"description\": description,\n            \"raw\": {\"date\": date_raw, \"description\": description,\n                    \"money_in\": money_in, \"money_out\": money_out, \"balance\": balance},\n        }\n\n\ndef _cells(tr_html: str) -> list[str]:\n    cells = []\n    for c in _CELL_RE.findall(tr_html):\n        text = _TAG_RE.sub(\"\", c)\n        text = text.replace(\"\\xa0\", \" \")\n        text = \" \".join(text.split())\n        cells.append(text.strip())\n    return cells\n\n\ndef _money(s: str) -> float | None:\n    if not s:\n        return None\n    cleaned = \"\".join(c for c in s if c.isdigit() or c in \"+-.,\")\n    m = _MONEY_RE.search(cleaned)\n    if not m:\n        return None\n    return float(m.group(0).replace(\",\", \"\"))\n\n\n# ---------- Midata semicolon CSV (legacy, kept for old files) ------------\n\n_SIGNED_NUM = re.compile(r\"[+-]?[\\d,]+\\.\\d{2}\")\n\n\ndef _parse_midata_csv(path: Path) -> tuple[str, Iterator[dict]]:\n    return \"default\", _iter_midata(path)\n\n\ndef _iter_midata(path: Path) -> Iterator[dict]:\n    with open(path, newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8-sig\", errors=\"replace\") as f:\n        reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter=\";\")\n        for row in reader:\n            if len(row) < 5:\n                continue\n            if not row[0] or row[0].strip().lower() == \"date\":\n                continue\n            try:\n                date = datetime.strptime(row[0].strip(), \"%d/%m/%Y\").strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n            except ValueError:\n                continue\n            ttype = (row[1] or \"\").strip() or None\n            description = (row[2] or \"\").strip()\n            amount = _signed_money(row[3])\n            balance = _signed_money(row[4])\n            if amount is None:\n                continue\n            yield {\n                \"date\": date,\n                \"amount\": amount,\n                \"balance_after\": balance,\n                \"description\": description,\n                \"transaction_type\": ttype,\n                \"raw\": {\"date\": row[0], \"type\": row[1], \"description\": row[2],\n                        \"debit_credit\": row[3], \"balance\": row[4]},\n            }\n\n\ndef _signed_money(s: str) -> float | None:\n    if not s:\n        return None\n    cleaned = \"\".join(c for c in s if c.isdigit() or c in \"+-.,\")\n    m = _SIGNED_NUM.search(cleaned)\n    if not m:\n        return None\n    return float(m.group(0).replace(\",\", \"\"))\n"
}
```

> AGENT

Two issues now:

1. **Old midata rows (asterisk descriptions) are duplicating the new XLS rows** for the overlapping Nov 2025 – April 2026 period — the dedup hash uses description, so same transaction in both formats hashes differently and both get inserted. (134 rows vs ~99 unique = ~35 dupes.)
2. The migration concept needs a clean break: midata was a stopgap, XLS is the real data going forward.

Honest fix: drop midata support, lose the ~99 redacted historical rows from Apr-Oct 2025 (they were useless for categorisation anyway), keep only the clean XLS rows going forward. If you ever want older data, the XLS download lets you pick custom date ranges.

> AGENT

Nothing landed on disk — that's the problem. Because Playwright runs the browser with `accept_downloads=True`, it intercepts every download into a `Download` object, but only persists it to disk if a `page.expect_download()` listener is active. Your manual clicks happened while the script was sitting in `input()` waiting for Enter, so the files got intercepted and discarded.

Two ways to fix:
1. **Best**: tell me which URL/page you downloaded from. I'll add a second download step to the scraper that hits that page automatically.
2. **Hacky**: add an "auto-save any download that fires" listener so your manual clicks during the pause persist. Useful while we figure out the right flow.

Either way — what was the URL when you clicked Download? Was it a "current activity" / "pending" page, or something else?

```json
}
```
